answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 673 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the dune. The velvet index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the trellis queue while honest participants promoted earlier goes on earning. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
